transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've asked us together because we have a senior product manager who has alleged retaliation after raising workplace-conduct concerns and is threatening both a civil claim and an administrative complaint. The employee is currently on paid leave, and we haven't put any resolution terms on the table yet. Before I approve any resolution plan or settlement framework, I want input from all of you — employment, HR, insurance, and conflicts counsel. So let's start by hearing from each of you on how you'd assess the situation and what considerations we need to factor into any plan we put together.
